notes.title: Community Update #2 - Vinyl Pre-Order, Your Content, and Current Plans.
notes.content:
Hello Jans! 

Recently, our Discord and Reddit have been literally taken over by Jan Dolskis. Our community continues to grow with new Jans, and you can't even imagine how moved we are by this. In addition, we receive so many positive words and reviews from you, which makes us really proud and motivated to continue this adventure together. And believe us, there's much more to come! Thank you!    

As this is our second Community Update, we want to dedicate it to you - Jan Dolskis. There will be couple of art from you, vinyl pre-order, and our next goals.   

[hr][/hr]Vinyl pre-order is available!
That's right! Right now you can pre-order amazing The Alters OST composed by Piotr Musiał, on a Vinyl. 

Available in clear and beautiful Rapidium-inspired, multi-coloured splatter: 

[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/9fce08652cc33487febd5dda9ae26f01bdc9f3c2.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/128cb44e9f50793dd36ff1e5de3c60dd27484fed.jpg"][/carousel]
Tracklist:

SIDE A

A01. The Alters Theme

A02. How Did I End Up Here?

A03. Home Far Away

A04. Rapidium Theme

A05. Project Dolly

A06. Molten Echoes

A07. Running in Circles



SIDE B

B01. The Last Stretch

B02. Magnetic Storm

B03. Alternate Lifepaths

B04. The Prism

B05. Getting Ready

B06. Going Home

B07. What if? (The Alters Song)

As Piotr once said: “While many sci-fi soundtracks these days favor the sound of analog synths, the idea behind the music of The Alters was a bit different. We wanted the music to feel more untraditional and mix digital, glitchy elements, unstable reverb with organic sounds, all of which together could support this unique story.”

Now you will be able to take part of the story to your home!

[hr][/hr]Jans are everywhere!
Yes, it's true! We see your posts and artwork that you publish on our Reddit and Discord. Believe us, each one of them touches our hearts. <3 We couldn't show all of them, but we encourage you to visit our community channels to witness them by yourselves!  

Below you will find just a glimpse of amazing piece of your art:

You also know that we are working on DLC and we have some more suprises for you in the future! We cannot wait to be able to tell you more about them, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello Jans!  



We are launching first Hotfix to address majority of the most popular issues, which you have reported so far. We are very grateful for your ongoing feedback, which helps us improve your experience from the game!  



Check out the details below (MAY CONTAIN SPOILERS!):



What’s gone:

No more getting stuck in Guard conversations.

Alters won’t block your progression by not going to Arc Sarcophagus on the final day.

Alters refusing to work will no longer remain stuck in that state in new playthroughs. If you’re already affected, please load a save from before the issue started to resolve it.

No more infinite narrative loops causing stutters, black screens, or save issues (especially in Act2).

No more black screens or missing daily saves when you’re close to a rebellion and move to journey / new act for new playthroughs. We are still working on a fix for the existing playthrough.


Bug Fixes:

DLSS Framegen and FSR3 not working - Fixed an issue where mentioned features were unavailable on the Game Pass PC version of the game. (Note that users who have V-Sync turned on might need to switch it off and on again for Framegen to become available)

Guard Conversation Softlock - Fixed an issue where talking to the Guard about surveillance could lead to a softlock, if you hadn’t triggered the early conversation before. The problematic dialogue now always completes correctly and no longer blocks progress.

Alters Not Moving to Sarcophagus - Resolved an issue where, in some cases, Alters (especially Miner) would not move to the Arc Sarcophagus on the final day of Act 3.

Alters Refusing to Work Forever - Fixed an issue where an Alter (e.g. the Botanist) who refused to work due to an ignored request would stay in that state forever after transitioning from Act 2 to Act 3. This state will no longer happen in new playthroughs, but users already affected by this issue will need to reload a save from before the issue began. 

Narrative System Infinite Loop - Addressed a bug where certain narrative systems would loop indefinitely, causing performance drops, framerate stuttering, black screen during day transitions and various problems with save files. The fix should resolve all of these issues. 

Journey Black Screen and Missing Saves - Fixed an issue where starting the Journey with less than 24 hours left before a rebellion could cause a permanent black screen and prevent daily saves from being created in later chapters. The Journey now starts correctly and daily saves are generated as expected for new playthroughs but users already affected by this issue will need to reload a save from their last journey. We are still working on a fix for the existing playthrough. 

Additional minor improvements

notes.title: The Alters - Expedition Log 4
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

As we are participating in Gamescom Latam in Brazil this year, we thought that's a perfect opportunity to tease another episode of the Expedition Logs!

Check out new episode on YouTube titled: "You probably won’t make it…"

[previewyoutube=14BRYYmVdpw;full][/previewyoutube]

Resources, scanning the surface and extraction
Expanding and running a mobile base in The Alters will not be possible without extracting the planet's rich resources. Metals, minerals, organics, and - most importantly - Rapidium, are vital materials you will encounter while scanning the planet’s surface. Yet finding them will be a tricky task, as you will often find their surroundings riddled with dangers.

Anomalies
Anomalies are lethal obstacles that pose various threats to our protagonist. They vary both in terms of looks and risks exposure to them entails. Some of them can be seen from afar while others will require an anomaly detector or a special tool to unveil. Anomalies can pose a serious danger to the mission as they can kill our Jan Dolski through radiation, as well as distort time and space around him. Luckily, we’re not helpless against them, as in time we’ll be able to create tools to counter their threat.

Biomes and collectibles
Multiplying types and threats of anomalies was one of the key features we worked very hard to improve during the last few months of The Alters’ development. The other one was the planet’s exploration, as we want to make biomes present in the game as interesting and filled with secrets as possible.

Stay tuned for another episodes of expedition logs!

The Alters launch June 13th

notes.title: The Alters Release Date Revealed
notes.content:
What if survival means facing the versions of yourself you never became? What if you chose family over going to college? What if your girlfriend from high school became your wife, and what if you actually lost her?

[previewyoutube=WF48QDkg3Cw;full][/previewyoutube]

Revealed today as part of the 2025 Triple-I Initiative, we announced that The Alters will launch on June 13, 2025!

Stranded on a hostile planet and racing against a deadly sunrise, Jan Dolski’s only chance of survival is to create “alters” - alternate versions of himself shaped by decisions he didn’t take. Each Jan is a separate personality - with unique skills, habits, and memories tied to their different life choices. But they also come with flaws, doubts, and emotional baggage.

Your success means managing yourself, literally. You must maintain a mobile base, make time-critical decisions, build relationships with your alters, and confront the consequences of their own past lives. Sounds easy, right…? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/479ee8ff9eca43af1763f6e378747382cf7d5231.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/a6ed4db39c0965a8a4cd8ecc0b11e1240af084e1.jpg

A new mechanic revealed in the trailer - which wasn’t shown before, introduces various deadly anomalies! Mysterious phenomena which will stand in your way during planet exploration - we’re talking levitating rocks, eerie distortions, heightened radioactivity, and other threats which sometimes won’t be visible for you without special tools. 

!! BE CAREFUL !!

In every case, without cautious approach, you risk instant death, radiation-induced injuries, or even disintegration of time and space itself. And, if that wasn’t enough already, the heightened radioactivity can melt your suit. These dangers add yet another layer to the survival experience, turning every expedition into a high-stakes puzzle. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/43d55c9867505078d96205fe4e76c6995b9cd893.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/7a69498b31f5a85cac0c73a4829d50fd6307f31d.jpg

Witness it by yourselves on June 13.

Mark your calendars and stay tuned for upcoming news!

Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/11bitstudios and subreddit r/TheAlters

notes.title: The Alters - Coming 2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42519165/4881a6c1cadad21470b64fe1efb5fc7a4d08672d.jpg

Subject: Project Dolly – Schedule Update

Dear Mr. Dolski,

First and foremost, we would like to express our sincere appreciation for your persistent enthusiasm and unwavering dedication to Project Dolly—as reflected in the multitude of messages you have diligently sent to our offices in recent months. Your keen interest in the mission timeline has not gone unnoticed.

Following a comprehensive assessment of Project Dolly, we regret to inform you that your scheduled departure has been delayed beyond Q1 2025, with a revised launch window set for later in the year.

While we recognize that this may not be the update you were hoping for, this additional time is being dedicated to further refining mission parameters and ensuring that all essential systems meet Ally Corp’s uncompromising standards. Furthermore, it is also allowing us to integrate new enhancements into Project Dolly, ensuring that your eventual deployment is more exciting and rewarding than originally projected.

As you know, “almost ready” is not part of Ally Corp’s vocabulary. This additional time will allow us to ensure that every aspect of Project Dolly operates at peak efficiency, leading to an outcome that benefits both the organization and, of course, yourself. 

Your commitment to Project Dolly does not go unnoticed, and we look forward to providing you with a confirmed departure date in due course.

Ally Corp Communications
"Always your Ally"
